limitations: One original complete generic static space-launch rocket exterior. Pointed widened fairing, long central shell, six clustered lower external booster forms and shallow bell-like outlets form one assembly. No previous airplane, underwater thruster, cylinder or rocket mesh extracted. One type only; no size, vehicle-name, colour, model/full-scale or detached-part variants.

Seven closed positive-volume surfaces: one continuous central fairing/body/external recess skin and six continuous booster/nose/external recess skins. Boosters meet the central body along polygonal tangent boundaries. Radial separating planes and nearest-surface checks verify contact without interpenetration. Mounting is deliberately simplified static tangency, not a mechanically engineered fastening or separation system.

External outlets have shallow blind visual recesses with closed backs. No engine, propellant, guidance, launch, weapon function, operational mechanism or buildable internal design is included. Exact vehicle identity, real-versus-model identity, scale, dimensions, rear details and internals are unverified/generalized.

Three decreasing LODs, nine BLEND/FBX/GLB reimports and35actual views inspected including native unlabeled128px LOD0/2. Fairing, tall central body, lower booster cluster and outlet silhouettes read as a rocket without logos or words. Assistant judgment, not audience testing or Unity runtime verification.

Original plain materials and authored geometry only. No photo texture, agency logo, national insignia, branding or exact rocket model markings. Per-triangle planar UVs intentionally overlap; not a unique packed lightmap atlas.
